title: This Is My Family
gist_ar: بنت بتوصف عيلتها: أخواتها وأمها وأبوها.

before_listening.en: Someone talks about her family. Listen for WHAT she is describing.
before_listening.ar: بنت بتتكلم عن عيلتها. ركّز على هي بتوصف إيه.

segments.speaker: Salma
segments.text: This is my family. I have got two sisters and one brother. My brother's name is Karim. He is ten years old. My sisters are Hana and Nour. Hana is my big sister. She has got a small car. Nour is my little sister. She has got a cat. Its name is Mimi. My mother is a nurse. My father works in a shop. Our house is small, but it is very happy.

questions.q: How old is her brother Karim?
